item.title: Diokno says House version of proposed 2027 national budget 'protected the old system'
item.description: Akbayan Party-list Representative Chel Diokno criticized the House of Representatives’ version of the proposed 2027 national budget, saying it “protected the old system”.

item.title: Prosecution defends withdrawal of 3 impeachment articles vs Duterte
item.description: House lead prosecutor Rep. Gerville Luistro explained the reasons behind what she termed as the “most significant decision” of the prosecution panel to drop three impeachment articles against Vice President Sara Duterte.

item.title: Pax Silica no threat to local livelihood, communities — Marcos
item.description: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr allayed public fear on the US-led Pax Silica initiative, saying he does not see it as a threat to local livelihood or to indigenous people's communities.

item.title: Quezon City gov’t scraps Task Force Disiplina
item.description: The Quezon City government said Tuesday it had abolished Task Force Disiplina after the involvement of its member in the fatal shooting of three teenagers in Barangay Batasan Hills.

item.title: Sara Duterte says ‘will never resign’ amid impeachment trial, allegations
item.description: “I will not resign. I will never resign from the Office of the Vice President,” she said.

item.title: China and PH need each other in trade, Palace says
item.description: MANILA – The Philippines and China need each other in trade and investment, the Palace said on Tuesday.

item.title: SC inks deal with LRA and SEC for implementation of eNotarization
item.description: The Supreme Court signed on Tuesday two separate Joint Memorandum Circulars with the Land Registration Authority and the Securities and Exchange Commission on the implementation of the judiciary's Electronic Notarization or eNotarization project.

item.title: Defending maritime rights is not 'being a troublemaker', says AFP
item.description: Defending the Philippines’ maritime rights does not make the country a “troublemaker,” Armed Forces of the Philippines spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea Rear Adm. Roy Vincent Trinidad said Tuesday.

item.title: NBI refers Duterte’s alleged SALN discrepancy to Ombudsman
item.description: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on Tuesday referred to the Office of the Ombudsman its findings on the alleged discrepancies in Vice President Sara Duterte’s statement of assets, liabilities and net worth.

item.title: 100 projects under 1 inspector: Ex-DPWH-Mimaropa engineer flags large DPWH inspector workload
item.description: Former DPWH engineer Felisardo Casuno took the stand today, as the Sandiganbayan Sixth Division held its trial on the malversation case against him, former lawmaker Zaldy Co, and others in connection with supposed irregularities in a road dike project.

item.title: Duterte makes another in-person ICC appearance
item.description: Former president Rodrigo Duterte on Tuesday appeared in person at the International Criminal Court for the second time in as many months, as he faces charges over his "war on drugs".

item.title: FACT CHECK: Hindi totoong tuloy ang BSKE ngayong 2026
item.description: Taliwas sa mga kumakalat na post sa social media, hindi totoong matutuloy sa November o gaganapin sa December ngayong taon ang Barangay at Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE) dahil ipinagpaliban ito at ginawang 2028 ang susunod na halalan.

item.title: JBC holds first round of interviews for new Supreme Court justice
item.description: The Judicial and Bar Council started its interviews on Tuesday with applicants Aldwin Alegre, Jason Barlis, Geraldine Faith Econg and Lily Biton who are vying for the position to be vacated by Supreme Court Associate Justice Amy Lazaro-Javier.

item.title: Impeachment court sets schedule in November
item.description: The Senate impeachment court has set a trial schedule in November.

item.title: Garin acquitted of graft in Dengvaxia case
item.description: The Sandiganbayan Special Second Division acquitted House Deputy Speaker Janette Garin of graft and illegal use of public funds in relation to the purchase of the anti-dengue vaccine Dengvaxia when she served as health secretary.

item.title: PNP warns Filipinos vs drug mule recruitment after Laos shabu bust
item.description: The Philippine National Police warned Filipinos against accepting suspicious job offers and against transporting packages for other people as it investigates a foiled attempt to smuggle hundreds of kilos of shabu from Laos.

item.title: PNP: Quezon City Task Force Disiplina members not authorized to carry guns on duty
item.description: The Philippine National Police (PNP) clarified Tuesday that membership in Quezon City's Task Force Disiplina does not authorize its personnel to carry firearms while on duty, following the fatal shooting of three teenagers in Barangay Batasan Hills.

item.title: Duterte misunderstood Marcos' statements on China money—Castro
item.description: The Palace also clarified that there are no prohibitions on trade deals with China

item.title: Co’s ex-bodyguard testifies delivering cash-filled suitcases to 4 residences linked to Romualdez
item.description: An ex-bodyguard of former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co testified that he took part in delivering cash-filled suitcases, which he called “basura,” to four residences associated with former House Speaker Martin Romualdez on several occasions from 2023 to 2024.

item.title: Defense: Dropping 3 impeachment articles ‘unfair,’ risks mistrial
item.description: The defense team in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte said it was “unfair” and warned of a possible mistrial as the prosecution expressed its intent to drop three articles of impeachment after evidence for two had been presented.

item.title: AFP backs Teodoro amid China's criticism of suspending military communication
item.description: Rear Adm. Roy Vincent Trinidad, AFP spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea, said during a press briefing at Camp Aguinaldo that communication must be matched by actions at sea, in the air, and on the ground.

item.title: ‘Puntahan natin’: Matibag dares Duterte to show 'misdeclared' property
item.description: National Bureau of Investigation Director Melvin Matibag on Tuesday challenged Vice President Sara Duterte to show her property currently under the agency’s investigation for alleged misdeclaration , after she denied ownership of the land.

item.title: SC dismisses indirect contempt complaint vs Sotto
item.description: The case stemmed from Sotto’s public statements on the decision in Duterte vs House of Representatives involving the impeachment proceedings.

item.title: Sara Duterte impeachment trial: Prosecution drops 3 articles, retains unexplained wealth charge
item.description: The prosecution panel told the Senate court on Tuesday it was dropping three of its four charges in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.

item.title: 'Balde' just one of the El Niño measures Marcos Jr. mentioned — Palace
item.description: The Palace on Tuesday defended President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. from public criticism of his suggestion for Filipinos to collect rainwater in pails and buckets in anticipation of the El Niño phenomenon.

item.title: LIVE UPDATES: Vice President Sara Duterte's Impeachment Trial (Day 39)
item.description: LIVE UPDATES: Vice President Sara Duterte's Impeachment Trial (Day 39)

item.title: 60 MV June Aster fire victims identified; 11 bodies remain unidentified
item.description: Eleven victims of the deadly fire aboard a passenger vessel in Coron, Palawan, remain unidentified more than a month after the tragedy.

item.title: Financial expert needed to connect dots in Sara impeachment case—Diokno
item.description: Chel Diokno on Tuesday defended the prosecution’s decision to present an independent forensic financial analyst in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte, saying the expert was needed to connect financial records and explain the allegations of unexplained weal

item.title: 'Numbers do not lie': Luistro denies Sara Duterte claim of fabricated evidence
item.description: “May kasabihan tayo, numbers do not lie.” This is how impeachment lead prosecutor Gerville Luistro rejectedVice President Sara Duterte’s claim that the impeachment prosecution was inventing evidence to pin her on allegations of unexplained wealth.

item.title: PNP eyes stronger digital probes vs human trafficking
item.description: The Philippine National Police (PNP) said Tuesday it was looking to strengthen its digital investigation capabilities to go after human traffickers who use online platforms to exploit vulnerable individuals.

item.title: BI to release mining exec Joseph Sy on Supreme Court order
item.description: The Bureau of Immigration said it respects the resolution of the Supreme Court ordering the release of mining executive Joseph Sy.

item.title: Sara Duterte denies owning property under NBI probe
item.description: Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday disowned a property that the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) was investigating for possible value misdeclaration.

item.title: P200K worth of smuggled meat seized from Manila grocery stores
item.description: Authorities confiscated over 650 kilograms of smuggled frozen meat products during joint operations at two Chinese grocery stores in Binondo and Sta. Ana, Manila on Monday night, October 12.

item.title: Sunog sumiklab sa abandonadong gusali sa QC
item.description: Ayon sa inisyal na impormasyon mula sa Barangay Immaculate Conception, isang bakanteng gusali ang pinagmulan ng sunog.

item.title: Kawatan, nagkunwaring 'jumingle' bago tumangay ng e-trike sa Marikina
item.description: Sapul sa CCTV ang pagtangay ng hindi pa nakikilalang lalaki sa e-tricycle na ginagamit pang-deliver ng isang water refilling station sa Barangay Concepcion Dos, Marikina City nitong Biyernes, Oktubre 9.

item.title: Road rage: Kawani umano ng LGU sinundan ang kotse na nag-overtake sa kanya
item.description: Ayon sa biktima, mula sa isang convenience store hanggang sa kanilang subdivision, patuloy siyang sinundan ng lalaki habang walang tigil na bumubusina at gumagamit ng high-beam headlights.

item.title: QC LGU fires Task Force Disiplina member over fatal shooting in Batasan Hills
item.description: The city government has ordered a thorough review of Task Force Disiplina's internal policies, particularly focusing on personnel recruitment, screening, and training.

item.title: ICC prosecutors update evidence list in Duterte case, remove 253 items
item.description: The prosecution team of the International Criminal Court (ICC) has updated its list of evidence in the crimes against humanity case against former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte, removing 253 items following a review.

item.title: ICC prosecution seeks to add 3 witness testimonies in Duterte case
item.description: The prosecution at the International Criminal Court has asked judges to admit the previously recorded testimonies of three witnesses in the crimes against humanity case against former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte.

item.title: Activists appeal Ombudsman's dismissal of raps vs 5 police officers
item.description: Two activists appealed the Office of the Ombudsman’s dismissal of their complaints against five police personnel on Monday.

item.title: LOTTO RESULTS: Oktubre 12, 2026
item.description: Narito ang mga winning combination para sa 4D Lotto, Megalotto 6/45 at Grand Lotto 6/55 para sa araw ng Lunes, Oktubre 12, 2026, base sa 9 p.m. draw ng Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO).

item.title: Bill to remove system loss from power bill OK’d by House panel
item.description: The House Committee on Energy approved on Monday a bill to remove system loss charges from electricity bills.

item.title: House approves proposed P7.2-trillion 2027 national budget
item.description: House Speaker Faustino "Bojie" Dy III highlighted the lower chamber's decision to fund health and school safety initiatives as the House approved on third and final reading the proposed 2027 budget on Monday.

item.title: Sandiganbayan orders 90-day preventive suspension of Jinggoy Estrada anew
item.description: The Sandiganbayan Fifth Division has ordered another 90-day preventive suspension of Sen. Jinggoy Estrada, as he faces a plunder charge in connection to the alleged flood control kickback scheme.

item.title: How online groomers lure children into violent extremism
item.description: Online grooming does not always begin with threats, explicit demands or obvious calls for violence.

item.title: Over P11.5 billion worth of shabu seized in Laos, Thailand bound for PH — PDEA
item.description: The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency confirmed on Monday that more than 1.6 tons of shabu amounting to P11.5 billion seized by authorities in Laos and Thailand were supposed to be brought to the Philippines.

item.title: Pia Cayetano, Padilla cast doubt on forensic analyst in Duterte trial
item.description: Senator-judges Pia Cayetano and Robin Padilla raised questions about the credibility of the forensic analyst — and his findings — who testified in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.

item.title: House OKs bill for rules protecting kids on social media, online gaming
item.description: The House of Representatives approved Monday on third and final reading a bill seeking to establish safety standards and regulatory measures to protect children on social media and online gaming platform.

item.title: PH Coast Guard repels 5 foreign fishing vessels near Kota Island
item.description: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG), in coordination with the Philippine Navy and Philippine Marine Corps, repelled five unauthorized foreign fishing vessels from the waters near Kota Island in Palawan on Sunday.

item.title: 3 Filipinos in ICU with 1 critical after Houthi strike on Riyadh airport; no deployment ban, says DMW
item.description: Three of the four Filipinos injured after a Houthi strike at Riyadh’s airport in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) remain in intensive care units (ICU), according to Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac. Of the three, one is currently in critical condition.

item.title: Rhian Ramos to pursue possible legal action over driver’s assault claims
item.description: Actress Rhian Ramos said she is already looking into possible legal actions against her former driver, who alleged that she, Michelle Dee, and Sam Panlilio physically assaulted and illegally detained him back in January.

item.title: ‘I am deeply sorry’: Suntay’s wife breaks silence on husband's Anne Curtis remark
item.description: The wife of Rep. Bong Suntay has issued a public statement distancing herself and her children from the controversial remarks the Quezon City lawmaker made during a House impeachment hearing, after his comments referencing actress Anne Curtis sparked widespread backlash online.

item.title: No double standard in impeachment proceedings — House justice panel members
item.description: Leaders of the House Committee on Justice asserted there was no double standard in its deliberations on the impeachment complaints against the country’s two highest officials.

item.title: DSWD urges stronger cooperation among ASEAN states amid global tensions
item.description: Social Welfare Secretary Rex Gatchalian called on other members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) for stronger cooperation amid global headwinds.

item.title: Man wanted for inciting to sedition surrenders to police
item.description: The Quezon City Police District on Thursday said it has successfully served a warrant of arrest against an individual wanted for inciting to sedition.
